title: ZuhG Life Surf Shop
blurb: Guests can rent surfboards, bodyboards, skimboards, and SUP packages with gear included. Surf lessons are available with different student-to-instructor ratios and include all gear. The shop also sells surf apparel, art, and hosts surf contests and events.
extraNote: At the shop at 5111 SW Hwy 101 in the Taft district of Lincoln City
meetingPoint: At the shop at 5111 SW Hwy 101 in the Taft district of Lincoln City
